items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: I think it was Arturo Langley.

ctx.x: Professor Mineta said, though, your father always showed him up. And they could read the stuff better than they could do it, really. Oh, yeah. Did he make you have a book when you started? Do you remember what book you had, method book and all?
I think it was Arturo Langley.
Oh, yes. Professor Mineta still uses that.
